description: Updates ONE user constant: rename, data type and value. Only the fields you pass change, and only those that differ from the current value are written (none passed: 400 missing_param; all unchanged: 200 with changes:[]). A rename is refused with 409 name_collision (details.collidesWith = the colliding tag, constant or block) when the new name matches, ignoring case, another tag, constant or block of the PLC; an unknown table or constant is 404 not_found. dryRun (Gd11) is answered by the serve (needs an open project): it runs the same guards and returns the plan {changes:[{field,from,to}]} WITHOUT changing anything. Maps to POST /plcs/{plc}/tagtables/{table}/constants/{constant}. M-off.

dryRun.description: Gd11: plan-without-applying — validates the guards and describes the action WITHOUT mutating the project

table.description: tag table that holds the constant

name: tia_constant_update
